integrity: Analytical uniqueness proofs and constructive matched-mean counterexamples; finite exact-rational and Monte Carlo checks are supplementary. Classical moment determinacy and published forward equations credited explicitly.
scientific_limitations: Exact stationary phase-conditioned spatial observations, known D and k, independent alternating durations with finite positive means. The released clock has moments of all orders, and moment determinacy is required to recover it. Recovering the released clock additionally requires its mean. Neither joint two-clock identification, finite-sample stability, nor independent validation is claimed.
title: One-clock identifiability and finite-moment ambiguity in a semi-Markov switching harmonic trap
